shortDescription: Cloud ONTAP file system(FSx) in AWS

options.name: aws_credentials_name
options.description: The name of the AWS Credentials account name.

options.name: endpoint_ip_address_range
options.description: The endpoint IP address range.

options.name: environment
options.description: The environment for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: feature_flags
options.description: Enable or disable a new feature. This can be used to enable an experimental feature or disable a new feature that breaks backward compatibility. Supported keys and values are subject to change without notice.  Unknown keys are ignored.

options.name: file_system_id
options.description: The AWS file system ID to import to CloudManager. Required when import_file_system is 'True'

options.name: fsx_admin_password
options.description: The admin password for Cloud Volumes ONTAP fsxadmin user.

options.name: import_file_system
options.description: bool option to existing import AWS file system to CloudManager.

options.name: kms_key_id
options.description: AWS encryption parameters. It is required if using aws encryption.

options.name: minimum_ssd_iops
options.description: Provisioned SSD IOPS.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the CVO/Working Environment for AWS FSx to manage.

options.name: primary_subnet_id
options.description: The subnet ID of the first node.

options.name: refresh_token
options.description: The refresh token for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: region
options.description: The region where the working environment will be created.

options.name: route_table_ids
options.description: The list of route table IDs that will be updated with the floating IPs.

options.name: sa_client_id
options.description: The service account secret client ID for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: sa_secret_key
options.description: The service account secret key for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: secondary_subnet_id
options.description: The subnet ID of the second node.

options.name: security_group_ids
options.description: The IDs of the security groups for the working environment, multiple security groups can be provided separated by ','.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified FSx in AWS should exist or not.

options.name: storage_capacity_size
options.description: volume size for the first data aggregate. For GB, the value can be [100 or 500]. For TB, the value can be [1,2,4,8,16].

options.name: storage_capacity_size_unit
options.description: The unit for volume size.

options.name: tags
options.description: Additional tags for the FSx AWS working environment.

options.name: tenant_id
options.description: The NetApp account ID that the File System will be associated with.

options.name: throughput_capacity
options.description: The capacity of the throughput.

options.name: working_environment_id
options.description: The ID of the AWS FSx working environment used for delete.

options.name: workspace_id
options.description: The ID of the Cloud Manager workspace of working environment.
